requirements.summary: Build a frontend page for Daily Production Report management with form for entering/editing daily production data
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes date picker for selecting production date
Operation name dropdown populated with all 17 default operations
Numeric input fields for today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand
Form validates all required fields before submission
Success and error messages display after form submission
Form follows existing industrial dashboard visual theme

file_operations.description: Create page component that renders the Daily Production Report form and table. Include loading states and admin authorization checks consistent with existing pages like DashboardPage.tsx and DispatchTrackingPage.tsx.

Create form component with date picker, operation name dropdown (pre-populated with 17 operations: Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, Front Wall, Side Wall, Roof, Rear Door, Blasting & Primer, Final Paint, Gasket, DLM, Plywood, Floor Screw, Decal, Data Plate, Sikha, Black Paint), and numeric inputs for today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand. Include field validation, submit handler using mutation hook, and toast notifications for success/error. Follow patterns from DispatchEntryForm.tsx and ProductionEntryPage.tsx for consistent styling and validation.

Create custom mutation hook that calls actor.createDailyProductionReport with DailyProductionReport data. Invalidate 'dailyProductionReports' query key on success. Follow patterns from useAddDispatchRecord.ts and useAddProductionRecord.ts.

requirements.summary: Create frontend table view displaying all Daily_Production_Report records with sorting, filtering, and edit/delete actions
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays all Daily_Production_Report records with all seven fields
Table supports sorting by date, operation_name, and numeric fields
Filter allows searching by date range and operation name
Edit action opens form pre-populated with selected record data
Delete action removes record after confirmation
Table follows existing industrial table styling with consistent typography and layout

file_operations.description: Create sortable table component displaying Daily Production Report records with columns for date, operation_name, today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand. Include sort indicators, edit and delete action buttons with confirmation dialog for delete. Pre-populate form when edit is clicked. Follow patterns from DispatchRecordsTable.tsx and ProductionHistoryTable.tsx for consistent sorting and styling.
Create filter component with date range inputs and operation name dropdown filter. Include apply and clear buttons. Follow patterns from DateRangeFilter.tsx for consistent filter UI and validation.

Create custom query hook that fetches all daily production reports using actor.getAllDailyProductionReports. Use query key 'dailyProductionReports'. Follow patterns from useGetAllDispatchRecords.ts and useGetAllProductionRecords.ts.

Create custom mutation hook that calls actor.updateDailyProductionReport with id and updated report data. Invalidate 'dailyProductionReports' query key on success. Follow patterns from existing mutation hooks.
Create custom mutation hook that calls actor.deleteDailyProductionReport with id. Invalidate 'dailyProductionReports' query key on success. Follow patterns from existing mutation hooks.

Integrate DailyProductionReportTable and DailyProductionReportFilter components into the page. Wire up filter state to table display, edit action to form pre-population, and delete action to confirmation and deletion. Ensure proper loading and error states.

requirements.summary: Add navigation menu item linking to Daily Production Report page
acceptanceCriteria: New menu item labeled 'Daily Production Report' appears in main navigation
Menu item appears in both desktop and mobile navigation
Clicking the menu item navigates to the Daily Production Report page
Menu item styling matches existing navigation items

file_operations.description: Add new route for Daily Production Report page at path '/daily-production-report' wrapped with AuthGuard. Import and configure the DailyProductionReportPage component. Follow existing route patterns for dashboard, production-entry, production-history, dispatch, and work-in-hand.

Add navigation menu item labeled 'Daily Production Report' linking to '/daily-production-report' in both desktop and mobile navigation sections. Insert between existing navigation items following the established order and styling patterns.
